title: System design review
summary: Assess a proposed design against the system's real boundaries: component responsibilities, data ownership, failure modes and the alternatives that were not chosen.

provenance.notes: Condensed into a review checklist; adds the requirement that every recommendation names the boundary it protects.

inputs.name: design
inputs.description: The high-level and low-level design being reviewed.

inputs.name: constraints
inputs.description: Operational, security or compatibility constraints the design must meet.

outputs.name: assessment
outputs.description: Per-boundary verdict with the evidence in the repository it was checked against.

outputs.name: risks
outputs.description: Ranked design risks with a concrete mitigation each.

workflow.step: Restate each component's single responsibility and who owns each piece of data; flag any with two owners or none.
workflow.check: Every piece of state has exactly one owner.

workflow.step: Check the dependency direction against the repository's stated layering and against actual imports.
workflow.check: Violations cite the import that breaks the rule.

workflow.step: Walk the failure modes: partial failure, retries, duplicate delivery, cancellation and restart. Ask what state is left behind each time.
workflow.check: Each failure mode has a stated outcome.

workflow.step: List at least two alternatives, including doing less, and say what the chosen design gives up.
workflow.check: The tradeoff is stated in terms of a measurable property.

workflow.step: Separate must-fix risks from preferences; reference the invariants any later review must keep checking.

constraints: Review the design that was approved; do not substitute your own and do not widen scope.
Prefer extending the existing execution path over adding a parallel one.
A design review is advisory and never grants approval of the design.

examples.title: Second scheduler
examples.situation: A design adds its own retry loop beside the existing scheduler.
examples.guidance: Flag it as a parallel path, point to the scheduler's retry budget, and recommend extending that instead.

verification: Each risk names the boundary or invariant it threatens.
At least one rejected alternative and its cost is recorded.

task.text: Review the HLD and LLD for coupling and component boundary problems.
Compare the architecture options and the tradeoff in layering.
Check the changelog wording for typos.
